Adjacent-IZ co-firing by replication stage

Source: R/izone_adjacency.R
summarise_adjacency_by_stage.Rd

Run summarise_pair_adjacency() for all cells and for each stage, and summarise cells and pairs per stage (means of finite values; median pair phi).

Usage

summarise_adjacency_by_stage(
  fired,
  pairs,
  cell_stats,
  rep_stage,
  stages = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4")
)

Arguments

fired

Output of build_firing_matrix()$fired.

pairs

make_adjacent_pairs()$pairs.

cell_stats

Per-cell table with n_fired_izones, p11, phi, p_expected_chr_shuffle (e.g. cbind(cell_info, summarise_cell_adjacency(...))), rows matching fired.

rep_stage

Stage of each cell (e.g. assign_rep_stage()).

stages

Stages to summarise besides "all".

Value

A list with pair_stats (stacked per-pair statistics, rep_stage = "all" or a stage) and stage_summary (one row per group).
